run_extract_asm_from_solutions: run the script to extract x86 or MIPS assembly from C/C++ POJ solutions in parallel
run_extract_mips_asm: run the script with mips asm type to compile C solutions to MIPS assembly via LLVM
run_extract_x86_asm: run the script with x86 asm type to compile C solutions to x86 assembly via objdump
extract_from_solution: extract assembly code from a single C/C++ solution file after preprocessing and compiling
check_var: check a C source string and find variable declarations using regex pattern matching
